link_the_profile_in_the_game_s_launch_op: Link the profile in the game’s launch options.
in_steam_open_game_properties_general_la: In Steam, open game Properties → General → Launch Options and replace the line with the options below. Append any additional game arguments you use.
add_this_command_once_and_use_i_added_it: Add this command once and use “I added it · verify”. MangoHUD, frame generation and variables will then read the updated profile on the next game launch, without restarting Steam. With native Steam, Proton can also be selected in PeliGames; Flatpak keeps the Compatibility selection.
select_proton_in_steam: To use {{protonName}}, open Properties → Compatibility in Steam and select that Proton version. It must be available in your Steam installation.
